assets/vo/s01-01a8afad.mp3: Here's how Claude made claude dot A I three times faster in two weeks, in under sixty seconds.
assets/vo/s02-8ae9e24b.mp3: Say the message box is slow, because you can't type until the page loads.
assets/vo/s03-57e82355.mp3: First, someone reports the slow spot. Second, Claude builds a benchmark that reproduces it. Third, Claude opens small pull requests behind a flag, an on-off switch, and watches real-world timings.
assets/vo/s04-820d0106.mp3: The benchmark counts CPU instructions, not milliseconds, because clock timing is too noisy.
assets/vo/s05-9a3e4a1a.mp3: If it got faster, a daily job lowers the allowed count, and any pull request that raises it fails. If not, the flag goes off and Claude tries again.
assets/vo/s06-d6f3fb87.mp3: One fix bakes an HTML copy of the message box into the page, so you can type while the rest loads.
assets/vo/s07-712595f0.mp3: Overall, the wait before you can type fell from three point one seconds to about half a second, and a person approved every change.
